headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 23, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a thrilling 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Mason Montgomery earning the win. Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense with a home run and three RBIs. In other action, the Boston Red Sox took down the Baltimore Orioles 6-3, with Jake Bennett earning the win and Aroldis Chapman securing the save.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Addison Barger, Patrick Corbin, and Jonatan Clase of the Toronto Blue Jays, who have been placed on the injured list due to right elbow inflammation, left teres major strain, and left plantar fasciitis, respectively. Other notable injuries include Samuel Basallo of the Baltimore Orioles, who is out with right shoulder inflammation, and Bobby Witt Jr. of the Kansas City Royals, who is dealing with low back tightness.

The MLB trade market has been active, with several notable deals announced. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres in exchange for Future Considerations. The Houston Astros traded Max Martin to the Kansas City Royals for Nate Pearson, while the Los Angeles Dodgers acquired Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Nick Frasso and Landyn Vidourek. The Chicago Cubs also acquired Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for Aiden Moffett.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling 5-3 Victory Over Yankees**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a hard-fought win against the New York Yankees, with Mason Montgomery earning the win. Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Yankees Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-0, securing a shutout victory. Max Fried led the Pirates' pitching effort with 5.0 IP, 7 K, 0 ER, 1 BB, 1 H.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Orioles 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jake Bennett earning the win and Aroldis Chapman securing the save. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 3 hits, including a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 5-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Dylan Beavers leading the offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs. Kyle Bradish earned the win for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall Short in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves edged out the San Diego Padres 6-5 in a closely contested game. Impact players on both sides included Luis Rengifo, Manny Machado, Ty France, Drake Baldwin, Ozzie Albies, Michael Harris II, and Dominic Smith.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Guardians in 3-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 3-1 win over the Cleveland Guardians, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Steven Kwan and Patrick Bailey were key contributors for the Guardians, while Gavin Williams had a strong outing for the Twins.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays' Addison Barger Shifted to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right fielder Addison Barger has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Marinaccio in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right-handed pitcher Ron Marinaccio in a trade with the San Diego Padres. The deal was made for future considerations.
